content: In this proceeding, the Court of Bolzano ordered the dissolution of ordinary co-ownership following a judicial separation. The judge addressed the non-final status of the property and vehicles, which were deemed structurally indivisible. Since only the plaintiff requested the assignment of the assets, the court granted her full ownership. A critical legal point involved the "fruits" or income generated by the common property after the separation. The husband had unilaterally leased an apartment without the wife's consent and pocketed the rent. The judge applied the principle of accountability, ordering the husband to reimburse 50% of the collected rents. This credit was then used to offset the settlement the wife owed him for the property assignment. Statutory interest was also applied to the rent arrears from the date of each collection.
